risks.title: Cross-tenant or cross-branch cache disclosure
risks.mitigation: opaque namespace, wrapped DEK, signed scope manifest, exact unlock checks and purge tests

risks.title: Primary auth bypasses POS actor cache lock
risks.mitigation: sealed pre-PIN ingestion and actor-bound unwrap; native secure key option

risks.title: Duplicate order/invoice/inventory effect after replay
risks.mitigation: stable immutable command, server fingerprint acquisition, claim, durable receipt/business links

risks.title: Wrong employee attribution
risks.mitigation: persist primary subject plus effective POS actor/lease in trusted command context

risks.title: Duplicate or ambiguous WhatsApp/provider side effect
risks.mitigation: transactional server event outbox, unique effect key, provider receipt/reconciliation

risks.title: Stale price, VAT or discount accepted silently
risks.mitigation: versioned quote, server validation, explicit conflict re-confirmation
risks.residual: offline promise cannot guarantee current price

risks.title: Oversell from stale inventory
risks.mitigation: cached stock labelled estimate; server atomic stock check; value/item policy

risks.title: Browser quota eviction loses unsynced command
risks.mitigation: persistent storage request, quota guards, non-evictable policy, block new commands, native option

risks.title: Service worker/page concurrent dispatch
risks.mitigation: IndexedDB CAS leases plus server command claim

risks.title: Local schema upgrade or application rollback orphans commands
risks.mitigation: restartable migrations, minimum readable version, rollback compatibility and quarantine

risks.title: Official number fabricated or duplicated offline
risks.mitigation: local reference only; database official sequence

risks.title: Logout purge deletes another scope or unresolved evidence
risks.mitigation: exact namespace tombstone, second confirmation, zero-residue and unaffected-namespace tests
risks.residual: user can clear all browser data outside app

risks.title: Offline actor remains usable after server revocation
risks.mitigation: short absolute lease, device binding, revocation epoch, financial caps

risks.title: Customer PII retention exceeds legitimate need
risks.mitigation: bounded index, retention policy, encryption, access/purge telemetry without PII

risks.title: Current 24-hour Core retention shorter than offline delay
risks.mitigation: approved maximum offline duration plus command/effect retention and cleanup policy

risks.title: PWA encryption overstated as compromised-device protection
risks.mitigation: explicit risk acceptance; native Keychain/Keystore option
